first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both currently declining, and archived evidence supports durable gains from shortening onboarding. This directly addresses the two observed funnel problems without the retention damage associated with promotional pricing. Verify the onboarding and activation records to confirm the effect remains applicable, then run a guarded standard experiment measuring completion, activation, qualified revenue, and retention.

final.rationale: Use the weekly slot for a standard activation-messaging experiment because the verified record shows a durable 6% activation lift, 11% higher week-one engagement, and a 1% retention improvement, directly addressing the current activation decline without sacrificing downstream value. Do not shorten onboarding broadly: the verified record shows 9% higher 60-day churn in complex-workspace accounts, so that option carries material segment-specific risk. Measure activation, qualified revenue, and retention by account complexity.
